contract: Respect-limits requests preserve FIFO within each priority, except max-priority requests ignoring limits are put at the front. Reprioritizing removes and reinserts the request; setting the same priority preserves position.

Assigned jobs cover a contiguous highest-priority prefix. New eligible requests take the job at the front of the unassigned list or take the last lower-ranked assigned job. A released job can immediately serve the first eligible unassigned request.
Job priority follows the associated request. Preconnect jobs can be claimed later. Auth-bound request and job pairs leave the unbound queues and retain generation and first pending error.
Stalled groups are eligible only with an available group slot and more unbound requests than jobs. Equal top priority preserves the first group in native GroupId map order.

Preserve native request and job destruction, callback ordering, cancellation, preconnect completion, backup timer behavior and existing public errors. Keep native job / socket providers behind the existing ownership boundary.
